Package renderer

Class Camera

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Camera extends Object implements Cloneable
The Camera class represents a pinhole camera model in a 3D space. It is defined by its position, view direction, up and right vectors, and the view plane dimensions and distance.

Use the Camera.Builder class to construct a camera instance.
